strings.life_tactics.intro: Look back on your recent choices with Saida. Shall we see what role each of your three tendencies plays on your team?
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed01: When planning a day off, I make time for a leisurely meal, even if it means skipping a place I wanted to visit.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed02: If I'm offered two tasks, I make time for something I've wanted to try for a long time rather than the easiest one to start.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed03: If I could try a one-hour class, I'd choose a subject I rarely encounter over one where I could use what I learn right away.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed04: When choosing a place to meet with a group, I prefer somewhere we can sit and talk comfortably for a long time over somewhere with lots to see.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed05: When choosing something to do together, I ask why it's needed before deciding whether I like my role.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed07: Even if I still have things to do, I stop for a moment to enjoy my tea while it's at its best.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed08: When a group project is finished, I'd rather hear from the people who used it than admire the finished result.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed09: I talk more often about days when something unexpected happened than days that went exactly as planned.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed11: When doing a repetitive task, if I know what it's for, I'll set aside other tasks that look more fun.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed12: If I could follow someone's daily routine for a day, I'd choose a stranger with an unfamiliar job over a celebrity in a field I know.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed13: After a particularly hectic day, I tend to improve my mood with my favorite music before sorting out my thoughts.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed14: Looking back on the past month, I check whether I spent time on what I meant to do before counting what I finished.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed15: If I read two articles about the same event, I'd choose one that interprets it in a completely different way over one that adds more details.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed16: When making something as a hobby, I prefer a method that's enjoyable to do by hand, even if a quicker way exists.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed17: If I could keep only one thing from a group project, I'd choose the notes for our next meeting over the finished keepsake.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_ed18: If I watched a movie again, I'd choose one with a scene I still can't figure out over one with a satisfying ending.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_vp06: I'm drawn to stories that let me see the same event through someone else's eyes.
strings.life_tactics.question.lt_vp10: When something good happens, I want to enjoy that feeling a little longer before moving on.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq01: When a little lunchtime is left, I spend it on a small pleasure I like.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq02: When something we are doing together is slow to work out, I remember why I joined in.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq03: Even in the neighborhood I always walk, I turn toward an unfamiliar alley when I see one.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq04: When I plan a week, I first set aside time for what matters to me.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq05: After I see an ending that differs from what I expected, I want to talk about that story with someone.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq06: When I make weekend plans, I am drawn to a place where I can laugh at ease.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq07: When I meet someone who does work I am hearing about for the first time, I ask what their day is like.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq08: Even on a busy day, I make a short break that lets me feel good.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq09: If the work helps someone, I want to take a role that is not very visible.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq10: When I look back on a day, I linger on moments when I ate something good or laughed.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq11: If I can choose between a familiar role and a new one at a gathering, I want to try the new role.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq12: Even when the result is not visible soon, I put an activity that matters to me back on the next schedule.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq13: When a travel plan goes off course, I become curious about what I might see by chance.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq14: Before an important choice, I think about whether it fits the value I want to keep.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq15: Around the time the day ends, I close it in my own way that makes me feel at ease.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq16: When I look back on a month, I think about the part I played for the people or work I care about.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq17: If I can finish the same task in several ways, I choose the one that is more enjoyable while I do it.
strings.life_tactics.question.tq18: I look again at a work I once found hard to understand and notice how it feels now.

strings.life_tactics.result.tr01.catchphrase: A first-time path makes me more curious!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr01.description: Think of the pleasure of stepping onto a new path first. This week, why not turn once off the walk you already know?
strings.life_tactics.result.tr01.name: Spark Adventurer
strings.life_tactics.result.tr01.share: My life tactics are 4-2-4, Spark Adventurer! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr02.catchphrase: I put my own meaning into a new experience!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr02.description: These tactics find a question worth keeping inside an unfamiliar experience. Give one recent scene a title of your own.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr02.name: Meaningful Explorer
strings.life_tactics.result.tr02.share: My life tactics are 3-4-3, Meaningful Explorer! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr03.catchphrase: That sounds fun. Let's try it once!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr03.description: When curiosity shows up, these tactics try it once with pleasure. What have you wanted to try that you could taste lightly today?
strings.life_tactics.result.tr03.name: Joyful Challenger
strings.life_tactics.result.tr03.share: My life tactics are 4-3-3, Joyful Challenger! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr04.catchphrase: I pass toward what I want to protect!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr04.description: These tactics set a direction by recalling the value that matters. Pick one promise you want to keep this week.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr04.name: Conviction Playmaker
strings.life_tactics.result.tr04.share: My life tactics are 3-6-1, Conviction Playmaker! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr05.catchphrase: The same dream still has a new path!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr05.description: These tactics draw several paths toward a goal you care about. If you added a small change to something you always do, what would it look like?
strings.life_tactics.result.tr05.name: Dreaming Designer
strings.life_tactics.result.tr05.share: My life tactics are 3-5-2, Dreaming Designer! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr06.catchphrase: Good work, in a good mood, together!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr06.description: These tactics keep worthwhile work going in an easy atmosphere. Think of a small kindness that would make someone with you enjoy it more.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr06.name: Warm Coordinator
strings.life_tactics.result.tr06.share: My life tactics are 4-5-1, Warm Coordinator! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr07.description: These tactics care for the daily rhythm that brings calm. Leave one moment you want to enjoy again on tomorrow's schedule.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr07.name: Guardian of Calm
strings.life_tactics.result.tr07.share: My life tactics are 6-3-1, Guardian of Calm! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr08.catchphrase: I want to share an easy day with you!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr08.description: These tactics look after your ease and the ease of someone you care about. Why not send a light hello to someone you were recently grateful for?
strings.life_tactics.result.tr08.name: Gentle Keeper
strings.life_tactics.result.tr08.share: My life tactics are 5-4-1, Gentle Keeper! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr09.catchphrase: Even a familiar place has a small adventure!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr09.description: These tactics bring a small change into a comfortable rhythm. In a place you like, choose something different from usual.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr09.name: Easygoing Free Spirit
strings.life_tactics.result.tr09.share: My life tactics are 5-3-2, Easygoing Free Spirit! I want to know your formation too.
strings.life_tactics.result.tr10.catchphrase: Today all three positions are mine!
strings.life_tactics.result.tr10.description: In these answers, the gap between the three tendencies was small. Recall a time when pleasure, meaning, and newness came together.
